in_sanskrit.name: Bipasha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bravery in appearance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bipasha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The goddess of fearlessness and fortitude, Bipasha signifies fearlessness and bravery in appearance.

in_hindi.name: बिपाशा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Blessed, fortunate, or happy one (from the Sanskrit words 'shukra' meaning happiness and 'shā' meaning she or her)

in_tamil.name: Bipasha
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Bravery in appearance
in_tamil.long_meaning: Bipasha ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। The goddess of fearlessness and fortitude, Bipasha signifies fearlessness and bravery in appearance.

in_telugu.name: Bipasha
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Bravery in appearance
in_telugu.long_meaning: Bipasha ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। The goddess of fearlessness and fortitude, Bipasha signifies fearlessness and bravery in appearance.

in_marathi.name: Bipasha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bravery in appearance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bipasha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The goddess of fearlessness and fortitude, Bipasha signifies fearlessness and bravery in appearance.

in_bengali.name: Bipasha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bravery in appearance
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bipasha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The goddess of fearlessness and fortitude, Bipasha signifies fearlessness and bravery in appearance.
